performance.verdict: Overdue launches explain the data gaps; money is live but stack is not.

findings.text: 5 SOW milestones overdue since 2026-07-31 to 2026-08-01: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting — none show a completed event.

CPL improved sharply — 28-day blended CPL is $234.30 driven entirely by 10 Meta leads at $63.60 each; Google Ads shows 7 conversions at $1,706.92 spend ($243.85/conv) with client-side pixel reliability unknown.
3-day lead signal (Sep 8–10: 2, 1, 2 leads = 5) vs prior 3 days (Sep 5–7: 1, 1, 1 = 3) is up 67% — a genuine short-term positive trend, all attributed to Meta spend of ~$62–74/day.
GBP actions dropped 77% week-over-week; last 3 days in series show 0 GBP actions vs avg of 3–5 in prior weeks — organic search visibility declining while paid is active.
GHL shows 137 contacts and 55 opportunities created but 0 appointments and 0 won — leads are entering the pipeline but none are converting to booked consults, suggesting an intake process gap.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; LSA and site launch are blocking ~$5,000/mo Google budget from deploying properly.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones due July 31–Aug 1 remain uncompleted: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site & Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting. These block proper attribution and the full ~$5,000/mo Google budget from running. Escalate to Nacer (Ops) today and confirm completion dates in writing. Success check: all 5 milestones marked complete with evidence by 2026-09-18.

suggestions.text: Raise Meta daily budget by 20% (~$12–15/day) — 3-day lead trend up 67% at $63.60 CPL, which is the only confirmed working lead source.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta is the sole confirmed lead source: 10 leads in 28 days at ~$63.60 CPL, with the last 3-day window (Sep 8–10) producing 5 leads vs 3 in the prior 3 days.
